_README: Hand judgements for every requirement the anchor pass could not map (2026-07-31). Merged into requirement-coverage.csv by rederive_coverage.py. verdict: COVERED-TEXT = an ACTIVE case genuinely asserts the behaviour but its spec_ref anchor is missing/mis-typed (refs-hygiene, NOT a coverage gap); GAP = genuine gap needing a case or an extension; NOT-TESTABLE = restatement / meta-statement / spec says no applicable case; CUT-BY-AUDIT = deliberately cut by the user-authorized 2026-07-28 Ruthless Usefulness Audit, cite the retired case; SPEC-BLOCKED = the spec itself leaves it undefined; DESCOPED = a PO ruling removed it.

SBC|S14-R8.why: SBC-EXP-03 (C30161) expected 5 verbatim: 'Customer names are plain - the "(N)" invoice count is not included.' Anchor cites S14-R5/R6/R7/R13 only.

SBC|S14-R9.why: SBC-EXP-04 (C30162) expected 1 verbatim: Margin % plain number to one decimal, no percent sign, EMPTY when Subtotal <= 0. Anchor is off by one (cites S14-R10..R13).

SBC|S14-R15.why: SBC-EXP-02 (C30160) expected 4: plain comma-separated .csv that opens as rows and columns, not .xlsx and not JSON.

SBC|S14-R16.why: SBC-EXP-14 (C30172) is the 10,000-row cap case for BOTH CSV and PDF. Anchor cites the pre-v12 numbering (S14-R14/S15-R22). Toast wording follows Chris Ward's 2026-07-31 Q2=A suite-wide ruling, which retires the SBC spec's own variant (Rule 32 newest-wins) - spec text pending his edit, on SPEC-WATCH.

SBC|S15-R25.why: Same case, PDF half of the cap. Anchor cites the pre-v12 S15-R22.

SBC|S15-R16.why: SBC-EXP-10 (C30168) expected 1: logo pinned top-right, scaled to fit without distortion. Anchor cites S15-R12..R15 (pre-v12 numbering).

SBC|S15-R17.why: SBC-EXP-10 expected 1+2: uploaded org logo first, bundled ShopView logo when none uploaded; step 3 drives the no-logo state.

SBC|S15-R18.why: SBC-EXP-10 expected 3: with no logo at all the logo column is not rendered and the text column fills the full width.

SBR|S2-R7.why: SBR-PERS-04 (C30274) expected 1 asserts the first-visit default 'Date range = This Month'. The retired SBR-DATE-03 was merged into it 2026-07-28; the anchor did not travel.

SBR|S2-N1.why: SBR-STATE-01 (C30298) step 1 drives 'a date range with no activity' and expected 1 asserts the Story-16 empty state.

SBR|S21-N2.why: Same observable as S2-N1 - the Story-16 empty state reached by a filter that matches nothing; the location route is one filter among the set SBR-STATE-01 drives.

TU|S1-R6.why: TU-NAV-03 (C30394) expected 3: 'The location filter defaults to the user's currently active location.' Scoping itself is TU-LOC-02 (C30443).

WIP|S1-R5.why: WIP-TAB-01 (C30451) expected 3 quotes the page title verbatim including the plain-hyphen separator. The retired WIP-TAB-04 was merged into it 2026-07-28; the anchor did not travel.

WIP|S6-N1.why: WIP-SCOPE-05 (C30460) expected 4 and WIP-FLT-08 (C30505) expected 3 both assert no Totals row when a tab has no visible jobs. The retired WIP-TOT-04 was cut 2026-07-28 as a duplicate of exactly these.

WIP|S9-R10a.why: WIP-EXP-02 (C30511) expected 4 covers the 'Locations:' line in both downloads; WIP-FLT-09 (C38916) expected 6 covers the exported column headed 'Branch'.

WIP|S10-R5a.why: WIP-FLT-09 (C38916) expected 7 (constant-width Location filter control) and expected 1 (fixed position, left-aligned).

IV|S4-N1.why: IV-NAV-06 (C30539) expected 2: 'No totals row is shown in any of the cases.' The retired IV-TOT-05 was cut 2026-07-28 as a duplicate of it.

SBC|S4-R13.why: First half (the 'Locations:' line in every export) IS covered - SBC-EXP-09 (C30167) expected 4 for the PDF header and SBC-EXP-03 (C30161) expected 7 for the CSV. SECOND half is uncovered: when the Location column is shown on screen, every export must also include that Location column. No SBC case asserts it.

SBR|S14-R20.why: SBR-EXP-02 (C30277) expected 5 covers the 'Locations:' line in all four exports. Uncovered: the Location COLUMN in all four exports in its on-screen position, with a Summary row reading 'Multiple' when the rep spans locations and an Expanded row carrying the invoice's own location.

PV|S6-R11.why: PV-EXP-02 (C30376) expected 3 covers the 'Locations:' line. Uncovered: the per-row Location column in both exports in its on-screen (leftmost) position.

TU|S7-R13.why: TU-EXP-04 (C30437) expected 4 covers the 'Locations:' line in all three downloads. Uncovered: the per-row Location column in both PDF views and the CSV, in its on-screen leftmost position.

IV|S10-R15.why: IV-EXP-02 (C30588) expected 4 covers the 'Locations:' line. Uncovered: the Location column in each CSV and each PDF whenever it is shown on screen.

TU|S8-R16.why: TU-COL-01 (C38859) expected 1 checks the control's TOOLTIP ('Column Selection'), not the accessible name exposed to assistive technology. The suite does test accessible names elsewhere (TU-DAY-01 C30418, TU-DAY-04 C30421), so this is observable and genuinely untested.

SBC|S10-N1.why: Retired SBC-SORT-07 covered it verbatim and was CUT 2026-07-28 as a no-op assertion (user-authorized Ruthless Usefulness Audit, build/report-suite/quality-audit-2026-07-28/). A test whose expected result is 'nothing happens' cannot fail informatively. Not re-authored.

SBR|S11-N1.why: Retired SBR-SORT-06 covered it verbatim and was CUT 2026-07-28 as a no-op assertion (same audit).

SBR|S14-R14.why: Retired SBR-EXP-09 covered it and was CUT 2026-07-28 as 'px font-tier edge minutiae, not manually testable' (same audit). A manual tester cannot measure an 8px-floor one-step font-tier shift in a PDF.

PV|S4-N1.why: Retired PV-COL-07 covered it and was CUT 2026-07-28 as 'stale-schema seeding not executable manually' (same audit) - a tester cannot write a mismatched stored schema version by hand. The reachable half (an invalid saved VALUE falls back to its default) is covered by PV-COL-05 (C30355).

SBC|S20-N1.why: The requirement's own verbatim text is 'No applicable user-visible negative cases.' Nothing to test by the spec's own statement.

PV|S3-R1.why: A pointer/restatement: 'one row per part, showing the columns currently enabled (see Story 4). Calculation ... is defined in Story 5.' Its substance is tested by the row-model cases PV-ROW-01 (C30341) / PV-ROW-02 (C30342) and the column cases PV-COL-02 (C30352) / PV-COL-03 (C30353). A case of its own would be spec-parroting.

PV|S7-R7.why: A meta-statement about the spec, not about the product: 'These rules are the normative visual spec ... this spec is the source of truth for this report.' Nothing a tester can observe in the build. (SBR's twin S18-R7.6 is anchored on SBR-VIS-01 C30305 and reads the same way - noted for consistency.)
